newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares buoyant, seen moving higher.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares buoyant, seen moving higher.

text.p: Austrian shares closed 0.5 percent higher in brisk trade on Thursday and dealers said further gains were on the cards for the ATX index despite late profit taking in futures.
The ATX index of 21 blue-chip shares advanced 5.20 points to 1,074.33, setting its sights on resistance at 1,080-1,085.
October ATX futures dipped 0.5 points to 1,068.5.
"There was enough demand in the cash market to make up for profit taking," said a trader. "There is still upward potential."
"One should be wary of too much euphoria," cautioned a dealer at another bank. "A period of consolidation would do the market good."
In continuous trade 16 shares closed higher and five lower.

Paper maker Leykam-Muerztaler recovered from recent losses, sparked by news last week that its Dutch parent was halting investment. Leykam was the day's biggest gainer, rising 4.27 percent to 305 schillings.
Brewer BBAG ended at a new high of 725 schillings, 24 up on the day. Engineering group VA Tech succeeded in breaking out of its recent trading range to climb 19 schillings to 1,430.
Steel firm VA Stahl was the biggest decliner, correcting after recent gains. Its shares closed 2.13 percent down at 367.5 schillings.
The broad-based Vienna bourse index edged 1.18 points higher to 413.91. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
